name: 3D visualisation
h1: 3D product visualisation and rendering without a photo shoot.
lead: We create photorealistic renders and animations from CAD data or references. Variants are quick to produce.
problem: Photo shoots are expensive, and every new colour or package means another session. Prototypes often aren't even available yet.
included: 3D model from CAD, sketches or photos

faq.a: Ideally CAD data (STEP, OBJ). Good photos and dimensions are often enough.
Colour and material variants cost significantly less than the first render. The exact price is in the quote.
Yes, we quote product animations separately.
